user.title: Set up Yahoo Fantasy Football
user.description: Enter your league id, or paste the full address of your league page. The id is the number in the URL. Your league's privacy setting must be Public — a private league cannot be read without signing in. Leave the season blank for the current one, and set the team id only if you want a sensor for your own matchup.

error.invalid_league_id: No league id found. Enter the number from your league URL, or paste the whole address.
error.league_private: That league is private, so its scores cannot be read without signing in. Change the league's privacy setting to Public, or wait for Yahoo API support.
error.cannot_connect: Could not reach Yahoo, or the league page could not be read. Check the id and try again.
